snippet.title: Grilluminati - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4703930/Grilluminati/
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/dMrCNGw4jf

Perform dark rituals, Sacrifice customers and feed them to their friends and family while conjuring an ancient grill god of your choice in this new co-op cult game.
